booking.title: Booking terms

points.p1: PeaceFlow is an intermediary platform connecting you with experts; it is not a medical facility, and PeaceFlow staff do not counsel, diagnose or treat you directly.
points.p2: Experts are independent and solely responsible for the professional content and quality of the session. Psychological counsellors do not diagnose, prescribe or treat.
points.p3: You get a 100% refund if the expert cancels, does not attend, or the session fails due to a platform error; cancelling more than 24 hours ahead is refunded 100%, after that the Cancellation Policy applies.
points.p4: Do not record, film or share the session without the expert's consent.
points.p5: PeaceFlow is not an emergency service. If you are in danger or thinking of harming yourself, call 115 or go to the nearest medical facility now.

share.title: Before you send

points.p1: The items you choose are sent only to {name}, never to other experts or third parties.
points.p2: The expert must keep your information confidential under professional ethics and the law, and is responsible for the professional opinions they give.
points.p3: You can revoke what you sent at any time. After revoking, the expert can no longer view it; what they already read cannot be taken back.
points.p4: PeaceFlow does not sell health data and does not provide it to insurers, employers or advertisers.
